templates.decoy_run.casual.run: Watch No. {creator_no}. This run isn't for the ball. It's to pull a defender away.
templates.decoy_run.casual.gap: {dragged_club}'s No. {dragged_no} follows. A gap opens in the middle.
templates.decoy_run.casual.finish.goal: Goal. Made by No. {creator_no}'s run, finished by No. {receiver_no}.
templates.decoy_run.casual.finish.shot: No. {receiver_no} shoots from the gap No. {creator_no} opened.
templates.decoy_run.casual.finish.chance: No. {receiver_no} is into the space No. {creator_no}'s run created.
templates.decoy_run.learn.define: That was a {term:decoy_run}: a run made so a teammate gets space.
templates.decoy_run.analyst: {Term:decoy_run}: No. {creator_no} pulls No. {dragged_no} {displacement} m out of position. {club} control of the gap +{gain} pts; {space} m² of space created.
templates.decoy_run.analyst.cf: Without the run, the gap stays shut in {shut} of {runs} re-runs.
templates.decoy_run.player: {player} has dragged {dragged_count} defenders today, creating {space_total} m² of space.
templates.decoy_run.audio: {club} attack. No. {creator_no} sprints {direction}, and {dragged_club}'s No. {dragged_no} follows. A gap opens {gap_where}. No. {receiver_no} runs into it.
templates.decoy_run.broadcaster: DECOY RUN · No. {creator_no} drags No. {dragged_no} · {space} m² created
templates.ghost.offer: What if No. {creator_no} hadn't run? The ghosts replay it without the run.
templates.gap_where.centre_edge: in the centre, just outside the box
